user.title: Epson projector serial bridge
user.description: Enter the address of the TCP-to-serial bridge wired to the projector's RS-232 port (9600 8-N-1).

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the serial bridge.
data_description.port: TCP port the bridge exposes the serial link on.
data_description.name: Name for the projector device in Home Assistant.

reconfigure.title: Epson projector serial bridge
reconfigure.description: Update the address of the serial bridge. The projector keeps its entity and history.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the serial bridge.
data_description.port: TCP port the bridge exposes the serial link on.
data_description.name: Name for the projector device in Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bridge, or it never sent the ESC/VP21 ready prompt.
error.invalid_response: The bridge answered but the projector did not return a valid PWR code. Check the baud rate (9600 8-N-1) and the cable.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to ask the projector for its power state.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the projector at {bridge}: {error}

projector_busy.message: The projector at {bridge} did not finish warming up or cooling down in time, so the power command was not sent: {error}

command_refused.message: The projector at {bridge} refused the power command: {error}

command_failed.message: Power command to the projector at {bridge} failed: {error}
